inScope: This record, committed first on the existing branch from baseCommit.

Ownership under a reading theme, from the cause observed on the site: a response may be made of the site's own components, with text, cards, grids, forms and images side by side under a theme attribute of the site's. Readela colours the reading text it recognises and nothing else; every other part of a response stays the site's as a whole, on the site's own background, whatever it holds. A wrapper that carries text outside reading blocks is such a part. The ChatGPT adapter names which of the site's components are reading text.

Reading-theme tokens for what Readela does own, where the owner found them too weak: table lines, and the bar of a quotation where a site draws it with a generated box. Original, Night as reviewed, the reader's own messages, code, mathematics, selection and Off are regression requirements.

Auto direction: a block inside a part of a response that stays the site's takes no direction from Readela, so the site's own layout decides there; and a figure with a unit attached (2M, 103K) is not counted as a word. Auto stays the default; paragraph-level direction elsewhere is unchanged.

Bookmark: the popup's first action reads Save, then Update; Return and Remove stay; the total stays. Two further browser-managed commands with no default key, for Return and for Remove, delivered by the existing background component to the page functions the popup uses. The popup shows which keys the browser holds.

An evaluation of one small site-integrated mouse control for the three Bookmark actions against the limits in DEC-143. It is implemented only if it can be done within Readela's present footprint in a page and without fragility; otherwise the limitation and the decision it needs are reported.

Memory: the cause of the growth recorded for head 73ec2c3, starting with the geometry read for a bookmark and a return; the smallest changes that remove avoidable work; a comparison of no extension, 73ec2c3 and the corrected build by the existing measuring script, including a one-hour run.

externalCapabilities.note: Load-bearing behaviour of the two supported sites and of the browsers. The sites were read in the owner's signed-in Chrome on 2026-10-11, with the build of 73ec2c3 installed there: element names, attribute names, computed styles, geometry and counts only; no conversation text, title or address was recorded and nothing was typed or sent.

items.capability: ChatGPT renders some replies as a tree of its own components instead of plain Markdown elements. The tree sits inside the root of the reply's text, under an element that carries the site's theme (data-theme), and every component carries data-d-component. Text components are ordinary elements (p, h1 to h3, ul, ol, li, table, blockquote, code) or spans, and carry data-d-text-flow; a caption is a span laid out as a block. Layout and interactive components (box, row, grid, grid-item, image, svg, badge, divider, form, radio-group, radio, checkbox, button, slider, pressable and others) are div, span, button, form and img elements. A diagram is an img. Components set inline carry data-d-inline. Colours are those of the site's theme: light text, borders and dividers at 5 to 15 percent white.
items.authority: Observed on 2026-10-11 in six conversations of this form and two of the plain form. In the plain form a table sits in three wrappers that hold no text of their own.
items.probe: A fixture built after that structure, in the site's dark and light themes; the end-to-end suite checks what is coloured, what stays the site's and the contrast of both.

items.capability: ChatGPT statistical card: a bordered box holding a two-column grid; each grid item holds a figure as a title element (h1, tabular numerals) and a label. The component tree takes its direction from one dir="auto" element at its root.
items.authority: Observed on 2026-10-11: of six figures, the two that carried a Latin unit letter had been given a left-to-right mark by the installed build under Auto, and the four made of digits alone had not; all inherit right-to-left from the root otherwise.
items.probe: The fixture carries such a card; the end-to-end suite compares the place of each figure under Original, Auto and RTL.

items.capability: ChatGPT quotation in the component form: the bar is a generated box (::before) with a border on its leading side at 15 percent white; the blockquote element itself has no border.
items.probe: The fixture draws the bar the same way; the end-to-end suite checks its colour under both themes.

items.capability: Claude: the direct children of rendered Markdown are reading blocks and elements the site itself marks data-not-prose; no other kind was found.
Both browsers accept several commands without suggested keys in one manifest; each is unbound until the user assigns a key, and commands.getAll lists each with its shortcut.
items.authority: developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/reference/api/commands and MDN manifest.json/commands, as read for the third ENT-246 record; the limit of four applies to suggested keys.
items.probe: The end-to-end suite reads the built manifests, lists the commands in both browsers and delivers each to the background component.
